title: Claude Dance Lab: Maximum Nonsense
authorship: Original procedural studies, not motion capture or a recreation of a named artist routine

clips.description: Side taps, easy rebound and relaxed arm pulls.

clips.description: Alternating diagonal reaches with a clean return.
